title: Test interval overlap enrichment with Fisher exact test

sources.locator: Fisher Testing: simulation comparison and shuffle workflow

scientific_use: Estimate whether two interval sets overlap more or less than expected given genome size and interval counts; inspect contingency table and one-/two-tailed p-values, with simulation recommended to validate low p-values.
tool_role_basis: Uses the existing bedtools fisher operation and shuffle/intersect simulation tests; repository includes algorithm implementation, but task can be framed as analysis use.

inputs.meaning: two interval sets and genome size file

outputs.meaning: overlap counts, estimated possible intervals, contingency table, Fisher p-values and ratio

dependencies: genome size and interval size assumptions materially affect inference

evidence.locator: 500bp/60bp examples; heuristic for possible intervals; evaluation against 1000 shuffled simulations

limitations: The possible-interval count uses a heuristic and docs warn p-values can be inflated; low p-values should be simulation-validated.
No biological study dataset is linked to the synthetic illustrative BED files.
